name: Woodworks Distilling Co
old_description: The story of craft distilling has been told down through the ages. Woodworks Distilling Company was founded to build on the roots of this time-honored legacy: small batches, local ingredients, artisanal attention.
about:
Woodworks Distilling Co. operates from a facility in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded by Dave Wood and David Alexander to continue the craft-distilling tradition of small batches, local ingredients, and artisanal attention. Wood serves as founder and CEO, drawing on a background in retail, warehousing, and distribution, while Alexander serves as distiller, bringing expertise in chemistry, regulatory compliance, and cocktail design.

The distillery produces a range of spirits including corn-based vodka distilled six times, a four-grain vodka, dry and barrel-aged gins, bourbon and rye whiskeys sourced through its Preface Series, and an apple-pie corn liquor under the partner brand Horns Down Fine Spirits. Liqueurs such as Encheva and Nocino are in development. Operations cover distilling, barrel aging, blending, and bottling on-site, and the facility also functions as an event space for private functions and live music.

Woodworks sells directly to consumers through its tasting room and online, and distributes to bars, restaurants, and retailers in Oklahoma. The Horns Down partnership extends the portfolio into sports-oriented occasions. The company also hosts weddings, corporate events, and chef dinners, managed by front-of-house manager Abbey Elliot, who has nine years of beverage-industry experience.

The founders state that wood influences every facet of production, literally and figuratively, so that each spirit tells a distinct story. They launched the business to write the next chapter in craft distilling, aiming to earn the trial and ongoing support of drinkers who seek distinctive flavors and provenance.

name: Workers LLC
old_description: was founded to serve the meat processing industry with reliability, expertise, and personal service. From day one, we've helped customers purchase new equipment, repair existing machinery, and stock the right parts to keep production running without interruption.
about:
Workers LLC, operating as The Workers of Wisconsin, is based in Neenah, Wisconsin. The company was founded to serve the meat processing industry with reliability, expertise, and personal service.

The firm acts as a distributor and service provider for food processing and packaging equipment. It supplies equipment from brands such as Hollymatic, Sipromac, Talsa, Risco, Rice Lake, Bizerba, and TSC, along with consumables including vacuum pouches, roll-stock films, bags, labels, and printer supplies. The company also provides equipment service and repair, installation and setup, and stocks replacement parts to minimize downtime.

Its customers are primarily meat processors, butcher shops, and food production facilities that require portioning, vacuum sealing, stuffing, slicing, weighing, and labeling equipment. The Workers supports operations ranging from small butcheries to larger processing plants with both new machinery and ongoing maintenance.

The business emphasizes responsive local service to reduce the stress and cost of equipment downtime, positioning itself as a source that keeps production moving without interruption.

Workwear Outfitters serves industrial, service, and governmental workers, supplying millions of end users with garments and footwear built for demanding job sites. Its customer base ranges from large industrial contractors to public-sector agencies.

about:
World Class Woodworking operates from Gilbert, Arizona, where it was founded by Frank D'Esposito. The company traces its roots to D'Esposito's emphasis on attention to detail and a vision for employee success, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom wood products including cabinetry for kitchens, bars, and baths, as well as furniture. It manufactures all of its wood door styles in-house and uses a CAD shop drawing process to visualize projects before fabrication. Services span cabinet refacing, refinishing, full replacement, and new custom builds, with installation handled by the company's own team. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

The company serves both residential and commercial clients, with a noted focus on the cabinet refacing segment of the remodeling industry. Homeowners seeking to update kitchens or bathrooms without full demolition form a core customer base, alongside commercial projects such as office cabinetry. The firm also works with trade partners like Decospan for its finest oak collection.

World Class Woodworking differentiates itself through hand-picked material suppliers held to high standards, the ability to match any finish, and a policy of accepting jobs of any size. The founder's stated values of integrity and craftsmanship underpin the operation, though no formal certifications or compliance registrations are listed.

name: World Finer Foods, Inc.
old_description: Max H. Ries, a German immigrant who operated a textile firm in his native Munich, left Germany in 1939 and had intended to develop a similar company in Chicago. But when he arrived in the U.S., he believed he would be better off importing food. In 1947, he founded Reese Finer Foods, and its major brand “Reese” quickly became the leading brand of specialty foods in the U.S.
about:
World Finer Foods, Inc. is headquartered in Bloomfield, New Jersey. The company traces its roots to 1947 when German immigrant Max H. Ries founded Reese Finer Foods after arriving in the United States in 1939. Originally intending to establish a textile business in Chicago, Ries pivoted to importing specialty foods, and the Reese brand quickly became a name in the U.S. specialty food market.

Today, World Finer Foods manages and markets more than 1,000 owned and third‑party premium food, beverage, and personal‑care products across over 60 brands. The firm provides a full suite of services — sales and category management, trade and consumer marketing, finance (order processing, invoicing, promotional spend, deductions, collections), and logistics (EDI, FDA compliance, inventory control, warehousing) — all supported by an Oracle ERP platform. It acts as the exclusive U.S. customer for its brand partners, selling to more than 350 retail and distribution accounts.

The company serves brand owners in the specialty food, beverage, and personal‑care sectors, including both domestic and international producers. Its portfolio includes long‑standing brands such as Reese (the top‑selling U.S. brand for artichoke hearts, hearts of palm, and prepared horseradish), Kitchens of India, Barry’s Tea, Nando’s, DaVinci, and La Posada. Customers range from traditional grocery retailers and distributors to emerging e‑commerce channels.

World Finer Foods emphasizes relationship‑driven growth, a philosophy dating to its early partnerships with European brands like Panni, Knorr, and Maggi. It is the only U.S. member of the Circle of European Specialty Food Distributors (CEISA) and a member of the Specialty Food Association and The Food Institute. The firm’s comprehensive approach — combining sales, marketing, finance, and logistics under one roof — is designed to let brand owners focus on product development while World Finer Foods handles market access.

name: Wyoming Authentic Beef
old_description: We do too! Each bag of our whole-muscle Angus Beef Jerky proudly displays the name of the Wyoming Ranch where the beef was locally sourced and is made with just 9 ingredients or less. Taste the Wyoming difference for yourself!
about:
Wyoming Authentic Beef operates from Cody, Wyoming, where it produces a line of grass-fed Angus beef jerky, sticks, and bites. The company does not publish a founding year or founder names in the provided materials, and no ownership designation such as family-owned or veteran-owned is stated.

The business manufactures whole-muscle jerky and formed snacks using beef sourced from Wyoming ranches. Each package identifies the specific ranch of origin, and recipes are limited to nine ingredients or fewer with no added hormones, antibiotics, MSG, nitrites, nitrates, or artificial ingredients. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Products are sold direct-to-consumer through the company's e-commerce site with free shipping on orders over $75 (excluding Alaska and Hawaii). The input does not list wholesale, foodservice, or industrial customers, though the ranch-traceable, clean-label profile would suit specialty retail, outdoor recreation, and better-for-you snack distribution channels.

The company emphasizes traceability and ingredient simplicity as its differentiators: every bag names the Wyoming ranch that supplied the cattle, and the ingredient deck stays at nine items or less. A published "Code of the West" underscores values such as keeping promises, finishing what is started, and knowing where to draw the line.

name: Wyoming Fudge Company LLC
old_description: Founded by Kristy Sims, Wyoming Fudge Company is a proud, female-owned small business built on a lifelong passion for premium sweets. Made fresh in Gillette, every batch blends real butter, fresh cream, and time-honored recipes to bring a sweet taste of the West straight to your table.
about:
Wyoming Fudge Company, LLC operates from Gillette, Wyoming, where it opened its doors on January 12, 2025. The business is the second act for founder Kristy Sims, who previously ran a fudge shop in Pinedale before dedicating three decades to an office supply store. After selling that store in 2025, Sims returned to confectionery, purchasing a building in Gillette to be near family and relaunching her brand as a woman-owned small business.

The company produces handcrafted fudge in small batches, using real butter, fresh cream, and time-honored recipes. Its Gillette facility was renovated with updated plumbing, electrical, and permitting to support production. The line includes assortments such as cheesecake, candy-inspired, and chocolate swirl flavors, sold directly to consumers and through wholesale channels. The firm also offers custom-branded gift boxes, dessert displays for corporate events, and a fundraising program for schools and non-profits.

Customers range from local boutiques, gift shops, and specialty markets that stock the fudge on shelves, to corporate clients seeking branded gifts for clients and guests. The wholesale program promises attractive margins and reliable local delivery. Fundraising partners include schools, sports teams, and non-profit organizations that run profitable community sales.

Sims says the company was restarted to fulfill a lifelong passion for premium sweets and to bring a taste of the West to the table. The small-batch method, real ingredients, and community-focused initiatives—including Ataxia awareness driven by the family’s experience—are cited as what sets the operation apart.

old_description: Our customers say we are their Best Vendor because we provide them with the Best Service of all their vendors. We do this by being a team of A-Players who are passionate about being the best we can, guided by our Core Values and our QMS. We provide the Best Service and Highest Quality laser cut, formed, machined, and welded parts or assemblies to customers in the chemical, marine, energy, construction, aerospace, and industrial products industries.
about:
Wyoming Welding & Machine LLC operates from Sheridan, Wyoming. The company was founded by Daniel Johlman, who started the business out of a desire to build a wider variety of challenging projects.

The shop provides contract manufacturing and metal fabrication services including laser cutting, forming, machining, welding, painting, and assembly. A Trumpf fiber laser handles cutting up to 1 inch mild steel, 3/4 inch stainless, 5/8 inch aluminum, and 3/8 inch titanium, copper, and brass. The company also fabricates structural steel packages for commercial and residential projects and works with design firms on architectural metalwork. Titanium is noted as a specialty, with thousands of pounds processed annually.

Customers span chemical, marine, energy, construction, aerospace, and industrial product sectors, along with general contractors and architectural/engineering firms in Wyoming and Montana. The firm delivers turnkey solutions from cut parts to complete welded and painted assemblies.

Johlman states the company was built to serve customers better than they have been served, guided by core values and a quality management system. The team emphasizes titanium expertise, turnkey capability, and access to state-of-the-art equipment either in-house or through subcontractors.

name: X-L Plastics Inc
old_description: X-L Plastics offers an array of sizes to accommodate our customers, as well as the capability to manufacture products to exact specifications. Our main products include a variety of packaging material, such as carton & drum liners, textile coverings, and mattress bags.
about:
X-L Plastics Inc operates from Clifton, New Jersey, where it produces polyethylene film and bags for packaging applications. The company employs approximately 175 people at its facility on Clifton Boulevard, serving customers with an array of standard sizes and the capability to manufacture products to exact specifications.

The company manufactures a range of packaging materials including carton and drum liners, textile coverings, mattress bags, Gaylord and box liners, and bakery bags. Its core process is the extrusion of polyethylene film, which is converted into both vented and non-vented coverings. Custom designs are produced to exact customer specifications, with the sales team translating measurements into finished liners and coverings.

X-L Plastics serves the bakery, industrial, and janitorial sectors. Its bakery bags are designed to preserve freshness, while its industrial and janitorial bags are built for heavy-duty use. The company also supplies textile coverings and drum liners for broader packaging needs.

The company emphasizes environmental responsibility, encouraging recycling and waste reduction in its operations. It differentiates itself through its ability to tailor products to precise dimensions and its stock of various sizes for immediate needs.

name: Y.C. Cable (YC Cable USA)
old_description: Custom cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer since 1985
about:
Y.C. Cable was founded in Taiwan in 1985 as a specialist in monitor cables. The company entered the U.S. OEM market in 1991 and established Y.C. Cable USA Inc. in Fremont, California, in 1997. Today it operates from Fremont with additional sites in Irvine, Piscataway, New Taipei City, and Dongguan.

The company produces custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses for OEM applications, supporting prototype, new product introduction (NPI), build-to-print, and repeat production. Manufacturing processes include wire cutting, stripping, crimping, solder termination, connector assembly, harness assembly, shielding, overmolding, labeling, and electrical testing. Programs range from quick-turn prototypes to high-volume runs.

Y.C. Cable serves OEMs in AI and data centers, automation and robotics, medical, automotive, consumer electronics, industrial, and telecom/communications. Applications include automotive sensor and infotainment harnesses, medical diagnostic and monitoring equipment cables, consumer USB Type-C and Lightning assemblies, high-flex robotics cables, and high-density power and signal assemblies for GPU servers.

The company emphasizes its NPI process that bridges prototype to production, engineering support including DFM review and component sourcing, and a global footprint allowing flexible manufacturing location selection per program. It highlights 40-plus years of OEM experience and certifications across locations including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and IATF 16949.
